thread:
Maria Lopez: Heads up — ACME on-prem delivery is scheduled for next Wed. We need the final air-gapped bring-up runbook + handoff checklist. GPUs: 4x A100 per host, 10 hosts across 2 racks. No internet. Can we lock steps today?
Samir Patel: I sketched sections: pre-delivery checklist, rack/power, OOB access, network prereqs (VLANs, BGP if any), offline image bundle, GPU driver + CUDA, kubeadm offline, container runtime, private registry mirror, validation tests, post-handoff support.
Jess Chen: For the offline registry: build image bundle as tar + repo mirror. Steps I use: skopeo copy container images into dir, then tar up dir. Example command (run in CI before shipment):
```
skopeo copy --dest-tls-verify=false docker://registry.redwood/prod/model-runtime:1.2 dir:./images && tar -czf images-bundle.tar.gz images/
```
Samir Patel: Also need to include RBAC-safe service account tokens for initial bootstrap, and a signed registry cert to import to node trust stores. No wildcard certs. Put cert + CA in USB with hash.
Raj Singh: Capacity comment: leave 1 spare node per rack for maintenance; plan for 10% spare GPU capacity overall. Also confirm PDU provisioning and 98A breakers per rack — power draw for 4x A100 + networking is heavy.
Andrew K: KMS notes: ACME wants keys in their HSM. We need to deliver a KMS integration script that does a wrap/unwrap test. Also include instructions to rotate keys post-install. HSM connectivity is inside their network only.
Jess Chen: Network pre-reqs to validate with customer's infra team before arrival:
- Out-of-band IPs for BMC/iLO per node
- Management VLAN + Kubernetes data VLANs mapped to TOR ports
- NTP servers reachable from cluster (or recommend internal stratum devices)
- DNS entries for registry mirror, private console, vault, and jump-host
- Firewall rules: allow TLS to internal HSM endpoint and to registry mirror IPs; block egress to internet
Samir Patel: On install media: prepare two USBs per rack: image-bundle USB (images-bundle.tar.gz, manifests, certs) and tools USB (airgap-installer.sh, drivers, offline apt/yum repos). Label both with sha256 sum.
Maria Lopez: Ops-bot — create canonical runbook stub in the runbooks repo and point to the bundle artifact.
ops-bot: runbook created: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/airgap-onprem-acme-delivery (please review). :white_check_mark:
Samir Patel: GPU driver steps (short):
1) Install NVIDIA driver 535.xx (package included)
2) Install containerd and nvidia-container-toolkit from the bundle
3) Load nvidia modules and verify with nvidia-smi
Expected nvidia-smi output example:
```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 535.54.03    Driver Version: 535.54.03    CUDA Version: 12.1    |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| GPU  Name        Persistence-M| Bus-Id  Disp.A | Volatile Uncorr. ECC |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```
Jess Chen: Kubeadm offline tips: pre-create kubeadm images and kubelet packages in the bundle. Use imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent and preseed /etc/hosts for HA API endpoints. Include a local kubeadm-config.yaml with controlPlaneEndpoint set to virtual IP on customer's load balancer.
Raj Singh: Validation checklist we run onsite:
- BMC access for all nodes via jump-box
- Confirm nodes boot to expected BIOS with SR-IOV and IOMMU enabled
- nvidia-smi on all GPUs
- kubectl get nodes shows all Ready and labels for gpu=true
- Run a 1-hour synthetic inference job (small model) across nodes to verify sustained throughput and no thermal throttling
- Run DCGM export and check Prometheus metrics collection
Samir Patel: For the synthetic job, use perf-runner container we build: it produces metrics and a token-per-second load. Command we run: kubectl run perf-runner --image=registry.local/perf-runner:airgap --replicas=8 -- requests: cpu=2,memory=4Gi ; scale replicas to saturate cluster.
Maria Lopez: Customer networking quirks: ACME requires BGP session for east-west fabric between racks. Make sure the TOR-level MTU is 9216 and annotate docs. Also they use private DNS zones not reachable externally — include DNS override steps.
Jess Chen: Observability: include Prometheus static scrape configs and a preloaded Grafana dashboard JSON in the bundle. Also ship an offline Prometheus snapshot containing node metadata so we can baseline after install.
Andrew K: Security/handoff: hand over SSH keys to their security team via key-wrapping with HSM. Provide an Ops runbook entry for emergency access: temporary jump-box cert valid 24h, rotated to customer-managed certs before acceptance.
Raj Singh: Cost/provisioning note to product: on Dedicated vs Private pricing, remind sales we need to include rack install fee and a 1-year on-site hardware warranty in quote. GPUs are expensive to replace if a node dies.
Maria Lopez: Final items for checklist before handoff:
- Confirm USB bundles exist + checksums matched
- Confirm OOB and BMC creds exchanged by secure channel
- Validate HSM connectivity with a wrap/unwrap test
- Run smoke validation (kubectl get nodes, nvidia-smi, curl registry)
- Upload runbook to Confluence and tag on-call rotation for first 2 weeks
Jess Chen: I'll draft the Confluence page from the runbook link and add exact commands + artifact links.
Samir Patel: I'll create the delivery tarball tonight and push checksum to the secure vault.
Maria Lopez: Great. Everyone — can we do a final run-through call tomorrow 10am PT? I want the checklist signed before shipping. :calendar: :shipit:
Andrew K: I'll be on the call and will bring the KMS/HSM test plan.
ops-bot: reminder set for 2025-10-15 10:00 PT — 3 attendees confirmed.
Maria Lopez: Thanks, team. I'll convert notes to the official handoff and attach hardware packing list after the call.
